label: Osteoporosis / Osteopenia / Low Bone Density
description: Avoid loaded spinal flexion, rotation, and end-range side bending.

label: Pregnancy
description: Modify by trimester; avoid prolonged supine and heavy abdominal flexion after mid-pregnancy.

label: Postpartum / Postnatal Recovery
description: Focus on gentle core reconnection, pelvic floor recovery, and progressive return to load.

label: Pelvic Floor Dysfunction
description: Focus on pelvic floor-friendly stability and avoid strong Valsalva or uncontrolled abdominal loading.

label: Diastasis Recti / Abdominal Separation
description: Avoid loaded abdominal flexion, intense twisting, and exercises that increase intra-abdominal pressure without support.

label: Chronic Low Back Pain (disc herniation, spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis)
description: Prefer neutral spine stabilization and avoid repetitive flexion or painful movements.

label: Scoliosis / Spinal Asymmetry
description: Favor asymmetry-aware posture, avoid aggressive twisting, and prioritize balanced spinal support.

label: Arthritis (general)
description: Respect pain-free range and avoid heavy loading or extreme end-range motions.

label: Knee Issues (arthritis, pain, replacement)
description: Avoid deep loaded knee flexion, painful range, and direct joint pressure.

label: Hip Issues (arthritis, pain, replacement)
description: Use smaller hip ranges and avoid extreme opening or loaded rotation.

label: Foot / Ankle Issues
description: Avoid high-impact foot loading, excessive plantarflexion, and unsupported ankle instability.

label: Joint Replacement (knee, hip, shoulder)
description: Favor controlled, low-impact movement and avoid high-load joint stress around the replaced joint.

label: Recent Surgery
description: Get medical clearance first; favor gentle, supported movement and avoid high-risk exercises.

label: Shoulder Instability / Impingement
description: Avoid heavy overhead loading, unsupported shoulder weight-bearing, and movements that aggravate shoulder instability.

label: Neck / Shoulder Issues
description: Avoid unsupported head lifts and excessive shoulder loading.

label: Bursitis / Tendinopathy
description: Avoid repetitive friction, compression, or end-range joint positions around inflamed bursae.

label: Respiratory / Asthma / Breath Concerns
description: Avoid breath-holding, rapid exertion, and chest-compressive positions if you have asthma or respiratory symptoms.

label: Respiratory / Pulmonary Condition
description: Favor gentle breath-led work; avoid breath-holding, rapid exertion, and positions that compress the chest or restrict airflow.

label: Hypertension / Cardiovascular Concerns
description: Avoid inversions and breath-holding; use slow, controlled movement.

label: Cardiovascular Disease
description: Avoid heavy load, rapid transitions, and breath-holding; favor low-intensity, steady movement and monitor heart response.

label: Arrhythmia / Cardiac Device
description: Modify intensity and torso positions; avoid sudden high exertion and positions that alter chest compression or stress the device site.

label: Diabetes / Metabolic Concerns
description: Use steady movement, monitor intensity, and avoid prolonged strain during blood sugar fluctuation.

label: Metabolic / Endocrine Condition
description: Manage intensity, pacing, and temperature sensitivity; avoid sudden exertion if energy, blood sugar, or hormonal balance is unstable.

label: Autoimmune / Inflammatory Condition
description: Plan around flare cycles; avoid high-load or prolonged joint compression during active inflammation and use gentler pacing.

label: Chronic Fatigue / Autoimmune Sensitivity
description: Use gentle pacing, shorter sessions, and avoid pushing through excessive fatigue.

label: Immune / Infectious Condition
description: Choose low-impact, adaptable movement; avoid pushing through fatigue, fever, or systemic illness and adjust for recovery capacity.

label: Active Cancer / Cancer Treatment
description: Use symptom-guided movement; avoid high load, aggressive compression, and unsupported effort during active treatment or recovery.

label: Swollen Glands / Enlarged Lymph Nodes
description: Swollen lymph nodes often indicate infection or inflammation. Favor gentle movement and avoid pressure or strain near the neck, jaw, or armpits.

label: Gastrointestinal / Pelvic Floor Condition
description: Modify core compression and flexion; avoid strong intra-abdominal pressure and pelvic strain that may exacerbate symptoms.

label: Neurological Disorder
description: Adjust for balance, coordination, and sensation changes; prioritize support, slower progressions, and clear cues.

label: Vertigo / Dizziness
description: Avoid rapid head movement, inversions, and unsupported balance work that may trigger dizziness.

label: Balance / Fall Risk
description: Avoid unsupported balance challenges and progress with stable, grounded movement.

label: Mental Health / Cognitive Condition
description: Use simple cues, extra support, and gentle pacing to help with concentration, stress response, and safe movement execution.

label: Overweight / Obesity / Weight Concerns
description: Favor low-impact, joint-friendly Pilates and avoid excessive load, fast transitions, or unstable balance work.

label: Vision Impairment / Blindness
description: Provide extra cueing, hands-on support, and ensure a safe, obstacle-free environment. Adapt balance and orientation work as needed.

label: Hearing Impairment / Deafness
description: Use visual demonstration, written instructions, or tactile feedback. Ensure clear sightlines and minimize reliance on verbal cues.

label: Epilepsy / Seizure Disorder
description: Avoid triggers such as flashing lights or rapid head movements. Monitor for warning signs and ensure a safe environment in case of seizure.

label: Severe Allergies / Anaphylaxis Risk
description: Be aware of environmental and equipment allergens (e.g., latex, cleaning agents). Ensure emergency plan and medication (e.g., epinephrine) are accessible.

label: Chronic Pain Syndrome (e.g., Fibromyalgia)
description: Use gentle pacing, pain monitoring, and gradual progressions. Avoid overexertion and respect individual pain thresholds.

label: Skin Condition (e.g., wounds, eczema, psoriasis)
description: Modify for comfort and hygiene. Avoid direct contact with equipment on open wounds and ensure proper cleaning protocols.

label: Transplant Recipient / Immunosuppression
description: Favor gentle, low-impact exercise. Monitor for infection risk and avoid crowded or unsanitary environments.

label: Recent Hospitalization / Prolonged Bed Rest
description: Reintroduce movement gradually. Monitor for deconditioning, orthostatic hypotension, and progress at a safe pace.

label: Pacemaker / Implanted Medical Device
description: Avoid direct pressure or trauma to the device site. Follow any device-specific movement restrictions and consult with the medical team as needed.

label: Substance Use Disorder / Recovery
description: Be aware of possible impacts on coordination, judgment, and energy. Use trauma-informed approaches and provide extra support as needed.

label: Other
description: Get AI-backed guidance for a condition not listed here.
